key_insight: Total deformation-based MPM prevents numerical fracture in perfectly elastic solids while computing elastic forces on the current grid for contact handling.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports simulation of elastic components undergoing large, recoverable deformations and contact without artificial breakup.
method: Compute deformation directly from particle positions using a fixed reference grid.
Evaluate elastic forces on the current grid, retaining standard grid-based collision handling.
Support particle-level collision handling and zero-energy mode suppression.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports efficient simulations of complex elastic objects under large deformations and contact, but provides no quantitative benchmarks.
watch_item: Robustness and computational overhead of the fixed-reference deformation calculation and zero-energy mode suppression require assessment beyond the abstract.
paper_title: Total Deformation-based MPM for Perfectly Elastic Solid Simulation with Strong Deformations
